coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Across the seven ground-truth variable categories, the design earns approximately 43% credit: it matches the training-regime comparison and partially matches evaluation controls, game-rule variation, reasoning performance, and gameplay outcomes.
coverage.design_error_analysis: It substitutes Llama-3-8B/Mistral-7B for LLaMA-2-7B/Baichuan-2-13B and does not vary learning rates or KL coefficients across the specified training baselines. It omits batch size 128, sequence length 2048, explicit shared dataset splits, geometric-mean scores, and most specified benchmarks. Gameplay diagnostics do not explicitly measure attacker-versus-defender win rates or cooperative success rates. Its Taboo formulation introduces a cooperative guessing team and an additional adversary rather than clearly specifying the intended attacker–defender game.
